translation: Original text of the Shennong Bencao Jing [本經]: Peucedanum [防葵], flavor pungent, cold. It mainly treats hernia and jia [疝瘕] with intestinal diarrhea, heat binding of the bladder, failure of urine to descend, cough and counterflow with warm malaria [溫瘧], and mania, epilepsy, fright, evil and running. Taken over a long time, it firms the bone marrow
